/// <reference types="vite/client" />

name: '$(Date:yyyyMMdd)$(Rev:.r)'

# Use the Azure DevOps pipeline templates
resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: 'pipelines'
      type: 'git'
      name: 'Azure/template-pipelines'

trigger:
  batch: true
  branches:
    include:
      - develop
      - master
      - main

extends:
  template: jobs/sonar-process.yml@pipelines
  parameters:
    prepare_scanner_mode: CLI
    prepare_sonarExclusions: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/node_modules/**
    prepare_sonarAdditionalProperties: |
      sonar.sources=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
      sonar.test.inclusions=**/*.spec.ts
      sonar.tests=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
      sonar.typescript.tsconfigPath=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/tsconfig.lint.json

    step_postPrepare:
      - template: steps/angular-lint-and-test.yaml@pipelines
        parameters:
          nodejs_version: 22.x
          run_unit_tests: false

      - template: steps/sonarqube-reports.yml@pipelines
        parameters:
          reports:
            - name: sonar.junit.reportPaths
              path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/junit-tests.xml
            - name: sonar.eslint.reportPaths
              path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/report.json
            - name: sonar.testExecutionReportPaths
              path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/sonar-tests.xml
            - name: sonar.flex.cobertura.reportPaths
              path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/cobertura-coverage.xml
            - name: sonar.javascript.lcov.reportPaths
              path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/lcov.info
            - name: sonar.css.stylelint.reportPaths
              path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/stylelint.json

# base stage
FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/library/httpd:2.4 AS base

EXPOSE 3000

# build stage
FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/library/node:22.2 AS build

ARG DEBUG_BUILD="false"

ENV NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"

COPY --from=acrprdfaurecia001.azurecr.io/cloud/azure/ca-certificates:latest \
  /ca-certificates.crt \
  /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

WORKDIR /app

COPY . .

## DEBUG_BUILD is initialized with a lowercase value
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc npm install \
    && npm run build:meta-env-bin \
    && DEBUG_BUILD=$(echo ${DEBUG_BUILD} | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') \ 
    && npm run build -- --sourcemap $DEBUG_BUILD

FROM base AS runtime

COPY --from=build /app/web-server-config/httpd.conf /usr/local/apache2/conf/httpd.conf

COPY --from=build /app/dist /usr/local/apache2/htdocs/

COPY --from=build /app/web-server-config/.htaccess /usr/local/apache2/htdocs/.htaccess

COPY --from=build /app/import-meta-env /app/

COPY --from=build /app/.env.dist /app/.env.dist

COPY --from=build /app/start.sh /app/start.sh

RUN adduser --system httpd --gid 0 \
  && chown -R httpd:root /usr/local/apache2 \
  && chown -R httpd:root /app

USER httpd

CMD ["/bin/sh", "-c", "/app/start.sh"]
# MES X.0 DESIGN SYSTEM UI

resources:
  repositories:
  - repository: mesx-ops-pipelines
    type: git
    name: MES_X.0/mesx-ops-pipelines

trigger:
  tags:
    include:
    - '*'
  branches:
    include:
    - main
    - ci/*
  paths:
    exclude:
    - README.md

parameters:
- name: isDebugBuild
  displayName: 'Build in DEBUG Mode'
  type: boolean
  default: false

variables:
  isMain: $[eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main')]
  caAppName: ds-ui

stages:
- stage: Build
  jobs:
  - template: test/jobs/jobs-node-static-tests.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)

  - template: build/jobs/jobs-docker-build.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)
      debugBuild: ${{ parameters.isDebugBuild }}
      repository: mesx/design-system-ui

- stage: Dev
  condition: and(succeeded(), eq(variables.isMain, true))
  jobs:
  - template: deploy/jobs/jobs-container-apps-deploy.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      azureSubscription: spn-dev-inf-mes
      pipelineDeploymentEnvironment: app_cloud_dev_mes
      containerAppName: ca-gptmpxn01-eun-dev-$(caAppName)
      containerAppResourceGroupName: rg-gptmpxn01-dev-eun-mes-01

{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2020",
    "useDefineForClassFields": true,
    "module": "ESNext",
    "lib": ["ES2020", "DOM", "DOM.Iterable"],
    "skipLibCheck": true,

    /* Bundler mode */
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "allowImportingTsExtensions": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "isolatedModules": true,
    "noEmit": true,
    "jsx": "preserve",

    /* Linting */
    "strict": true,
    "noUnusedLocals": true,
    "noUnusedParameters": true,
    "noFallthroughCasesInSwitch": true,

    "outDir": "./dist",
    "baseUrl": "./",
    "paths": {
      "@/*": ["src/*"]
    }
  },
  "references": [{ "path": "./tsconfig.node.json" }],
  "include": ["src/**/*.ts", "src/**/*.tsx", "src/**/*.vue", "src/main.ts", "src/service/store.js", "src/localization/i18n.ts"]
}
